title: 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics Fee Schedule — Rates by Activity and Grade, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees — 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule, scheduled rate.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the scheduled rate of the participation fee is set by the activity registered and by the grade on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, as kept by Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions:

- **75.00** for the robotics team when that enrollment record shows grade 06 or above;
- **45.00** for one-act play when that enrollment record shows grade 09 or above;
- otherwise, the UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation fee of the activity fee catalogue (35.00).

| Activity registered | Grade on the enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | Scheduled rate |
|---|---|---|
| robotics | 06 through 12 | 75.00 |
| robotics | 02 through 05 | catalogue participation fee, 35.00 |
| one-act play | 09 through 12 | 45.00 |
| one-act play | 02 through 08 | catalogue participation fee, 35.00 |
| UIL academics | any grade | catalogue participation fee, 35.00 |
| any activity | no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | catalogue participation fee, 35.00 |

Both parts of each of the first two tiers must hold together: the activity and the grade. The grade boundaries sit at 06 for robotics (grade 05 takes the catalogue fee, grade 06 takes 75.00) and at 09 for one-act play (grade 08 takes the catalogue fee, grade 09 takes 45.00). The grade read is the one on the enrollment record of the same school year as the participation; an enrollment record of another school year, or one in a status other than enrolled, is not the record this schedule reads.
